name: H1: Noise bottleneck (noise_dim=4)
theory: When dim(z) << dim(cells), CLN with shared spatial weights forces CRPS-optimality to require inter-cell correlation. 4 dims for 25 cells creates a binding bottleneck.
target: CI>0.80 AND corr>0.80 simultaneously at sw=0.5
risk: FGN mechanism may not transfer from D=87M to D=750. Residuals may need higher noise dim than full generation.
kill_condition: No noise_dim in {2,4,8} achieves corr>0.80 AND CI>0.70 at sw=0.5

name: H4: Per-frame Energy Score (D=25)
theory: ES at D=25 per frame provides 4% correlation gradient signal (vs 0.13% at D=750). Combined with afCRPS, provides both marginal and joint gradient in single training run.
risk: ES may still be too weak at D=25. May conflict with afCRPS like VS did.
kill_condition: No lambda_es achieves corr>0.85 with CI>0.70

name: H2: End-to-end training (no frozen base)
theory: Frozen pipeline constrains optimization landscape. End-to-end lets model find own factorization of conditional distribution. All leading systems (AIFS, FGN, GenCast) train end-to-end.
risk: 441 windows may be insufficient for end-to-end. Slower convergence without warm start.

stages.desc: Full 200ep if S1 shows reasonable mae

kill_condition: mae > 2x 153a at ep80 (can't learn mean) OR CI < 0.60 at ep200
